creature_families.label: Player body
creature_families.note: per-player entity with direction, speed, last split time; up to 16 per player

creature_families.label: Food pellet
creature_families.note: mass 2 to 4, target 600 on the map, refilled by timer

top_creatures.label: Split-and-rejoin body cluster
top_creatures.why: one player becomes many bodies that pull back together; readable many-from-one ring at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: split cap, half-mass split, gravity ramp for the last 2 s before merge, 5 s delay
top_creatures.change: bodies become short-lived attack-capable shards; merge is a fight beat with hit-stop, not a mass add

top_creatures.label: Heavy slow body
top_creatures.why: size makes movement slower, a clear weight read
top_creatures.keep: speed falls with the square root of mass
top_creatures.change: use our weight class table, not the raw formula

top_creatures.label: Pulsing pellet
top_creatures.why: small pickups pulse faster than large bodies (rate 5.0 against 2.2), so size reads at a glance
top_creatures.change: pulse ties to loot rarity, not size

top_creatures.label: Wobbling outline
top_creatures.why: seven-lobe sine wobble on the rim makes a still shape look alive
top_creatures.change: lobe count and amplitude are ours

top_creatures.label: Decaying giant
top_creatures.why: big bodies lose 1 percent of mass every 5 s down to base mass: a quiet pressure to keep moving
top_creatures.keep: floor at base mass; slow timer
top_creatures.change: apply to a meter we own (focus); keep float state so the integer cast does not truncate

zones.label: Open square arena
zones.note: world size 1000 from the config row; border and backdrop are client art (not read here)

looks.label: Layered halo disc
looks.technique: outer halo at low alpha, body disc, inner core, offset highlight; halo radius pulses with time

looks.label: Consumed pickup slides into eater and shrinks
looks.technique: tween toward target over 0.2 s, scale to zero, draw-order bump so it renders above the eater, then destroy

looks.label: Position interpolation between server updates
looks.technique: lerp to last server position over 100 ms

looks.label: Palette by player index
looks.technique: index modulo palette length; values not copied

looks.label: Rim wobble polyline
looks.technique: about 72-point polyline with sine offset per point

looks.label: Layered starfield with twinkle
looks.technique: three low-alpha nebula discs plus per-star sine twinkle

looks.label: Mass-capped camera zoom-out
looks.technique: size = 50 + min(50, mass/5) + 30 when more than one body; zoom eased per second

originals.name: Mirror Shards
originals.idea: a time-limited hero ability that splits into a few half-strength shards which pull back together in the last two seconds
originals.keep: time-limited split, half strength, pull-back before merge
originals.change: shards attack, cap at 3, merge is a fight beat with hit-stop; server-verified like any engage (rows 4 and 9)

originals.name: Heavy Tide
originals.idea: an elite whose weight slows it on a square-root curve and that absorbs only smaller fallen minions
originals.keep: square-root speed falloff; absorb only below 0.85 size ratio
originals.change: absorbing heals or extends reach; no player bodies are absorbed (rows 7 and 18)

originals.name: Ember Motes
originals.idea: loot pickups that pulse faster when small and slide into the collector over 0.2 s
originals.keep: pulse by size; slide and shrink into collector with draw-order bump
originals.change: rarity sets colour and sound per tier; phone inspect flow per loot ruling (rows 18 and 12)

originals.name: Fading Focus
originals.idea: a hero resource that decays on a slow timer and stops at a base floor
originals.change: focus meter, 1 percent every 5 s above base, kept as float (rows 3 and 14)

originals.name: Breathing Camera
originals.idea: zoom-out capped by mass and by extra bodies
originals.change: cap tied to hero weight class and combo count (row 11)

originals.name: Shore Arena
originals.idea: one bounded arena with a layered starfield backdrop
originals.change: fight arena with a corner hazard instead of open pickups; arena as zone data record (row 23)
